text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin had requested to focus on weight training
for today's workout.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I headed over to the gym, I found her
just about to lift a barbell.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, time to—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However—the moment she took the barbell's weight,
her slender frame wobbled unsteadily...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh... heavy...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I helped support the barbell with her
and slowly lowered it down to the floor.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... Dammit...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To avoid injury,
it seemed wise to spend more time warming up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What? You trying to say this is too much for me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Telling me not to act tough when I barely have any muscle?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Judging from how she looked, she definitely had
the strength to lift the barbell.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suggested that she was simply under-warmed,
and that doing a more thorough routine would help—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Though clearly reluctant,
Narita Taishin ended up following my instructions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Using the treadmill for a light jog to raise her body temperature and heart rate,
she followed up by stretching out her muscles thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And once her meticulous prep was complete,
she stood before the barbell once more—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, ...huph!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With far greater stability than before,
she lifted the barbell cleanly.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Alright...!
choice_data_list: Feels a lot better, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I guess. A little.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Despite her nonchalant response, she seemed to be in good form.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her dumbbell routine went smoothly as well.
Fixing the slight wobble in her core should make it even better.
choice_data_list: Could you try keeping your upper body straight?
Can you try keeping your upper body straight?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Throughout the rest of the workout, she seemed noticeably
more receptive to my advice than usual...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, while we were reviewing the day's training...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Mm... pretty okay.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh, but... hey, um.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...That warm-up routine you had me do,
might not be a bad idea to do every time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that... well,
my body felt a lot lighter than usual, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Hearing far more positive feedback than I expected,
I accidentally leaned in a bit too eagerly.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what's with you all of a sudden...? Your energy's annoying.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Are we done with the review? Then I'm going back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our dynamic certainly wasn't bad.
And yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I couldn't help but feel there were still plenty of hurdles ahead for us as partners...
